name.description: A short name for this chapter — evocative, not a deadline.

carryAsLearning.description: One thing from the last stretch you want to bring forward.
carryAsLearning.example: e.g. Protecting mornings mattered more than any to-do list.

statement.description: Finish the sentence in a few words.

feelings.description: A few feelings you want this season to have. One per line.

newPriority.description: A focus that isn't a life area yet.

decisions30.description: Small experiments or decisions for the next month. One per line.

decisions60.description: Slightly further out. One per line.
decisions60.example: e.g. Decide whether to keep the Tuesday commitment

decisions90.description: The horizon of this season. One per line.

practices.description: Repeatable things that support the season. One per line.

supports.description: People, tools, or conditions you can lean on. One per line.

constraints.description: Honest limits to design around, without judgement. One per line.
constraints.example: e.g. Low energy until the meds settle

enough.description: Name "enough" now, so you can recognise it later.
enough.example: e.g. If mornings stay mine, this season did its work.

notNow.description: What you're deliberately not doing now — resting, not backlog. One per line.

celebration.description: Something worth marking from this season.
celebration.example: e.g. I kept the promise about mornings.

learning.example: e.g. Constraints made me more, not less, creative.

identity.description: A way you changed across this chapter.
identity.example: e.g. Someone who stops at enough.

priorities.description: Up to three areas that deserve the clearest attention now.
